items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: See, so Baron come in and said to me, "Son, would you like to come to New York?"

ctx.x: relieve yourself." She said, because, "And take a rest, because I'm tired of singing."

So, anyhow, we got along very nicely. But before the season was over, a man came down from New York, which everybody knew at that time was the boss of Harlem, was Baron Wilkins. Baron Wilkins come down and said he was looking for a band. And he asked Charley Reynolds, "What about the band you've got?" Because the season was about to close down there. So, Charley Reynolds said, "Hey this guy is good. He's a young kid, he's trying to get going and one thing, he tends to business. I don't know what he does after the…
Now, before we leave Atlantic City, I wanted to ask you about some of the other performers who were around when you got back there. Was like, Frankie, 'half-pint', Jackson, was --
